gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU
input_io: JPEGs preloaded; disk input and all output writes excluded
f01_scope: idle start; staging memcpy, metadata/support validation and decode through detect-stream synchronization to RGB delivery; not decoder-engine busy time
f02_scope: isolated after F01 completion; same RGB, NativePreprocessor horizontal/vertical FP32 resize; CUDA events enclose validation/submission gaps as well as kernels
overlap: none between F01 and F02 or frames; isolated measurements cannot be added to overlapping pipeline timings
percentiles: nearest rank of individual measured-frame samples; all outliers retained
